messages:
Alex (AE): starting RivalOne migration POC thread. Prospect goal: minimal client changes, exact parity for three compliance flows, clear per-request billing for audits, SSO + BYOK, and a dev sandbox. SE/Sec/Pricing please advise.

Priyanka (SE): quick overview: RivalOne uses a /v1/generate endpoint today over HTTPS, ~420k tokens/day, avg 70 tokens. Main blockers: deterministic templates (must be byte-for-byte), tokenizer differences causing billing deltas, and retry semantics.

Ethan (RivalOne Eng): true. We have 3 legal templates that must be identical. We can share a 1k-sample set and their last 30d token histogram. Need sandbox IPs and a shim to avoid changing many clients.

Priyanka (SE): plan: 1) provide a tiny adapter that maps their /v1/generate body to Redwood /responses so no client lib changes; 2) run parity harness with metrics: exact-match for golden set, tokenizer token-delta, and semantic-sim for the rest; 3) provide per-request traces (id, tokens_in/out, model) for reconciliation.

Priyanka (SE): adapter snippet:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"{{text}}","max_tokens":{{max}},"model":"redwood-stable"}'
```

Sam (Security): BYOK/KMS: supported on Dedicated and Private. Hosted uses envelope encryption by default; hosted BYOK not available today. SSO/SCIM: supported for console/team provisioning. Default audit log retention is 90d (masked); retention extension is contractual. We'll need their filled vendor questionnaire.

Sam (Security): privacy note: per-request traces can be hashed or masked by default; if they need raw prompt export that requires a contract and PS for secure transfer.

Leah (Pricing): rough ballpark: hosted generation $0.0065 / 1k tokens. Dedicated reserved estimate for their volume ~ $32k/month (6mo term); 12mo lowers effective cost. Onboarding fee for Private; PS for KMS automation may apply. Will produce formal scenarios after invoices.

Ethan (RivalOne Eng): acceptance criteria from our side: 1) 3 golden templates -> exact byte-for-byte match. 2) token accounting delta <=2% across 2k prompts. 3) semantic sim >=0.95 for samples. 4) per-request trace exported or available for reconciliation. 5) p95 latency <300ms on Dedicated for short prompts. 6) no silent truncation on retries.

Priyanka (SE): we can run a 200-prompt smoke in the sandbox tonight, then the full 2k run during the POC week. We'll include tokenizer side-by-side outputs and a reconciliation report.

env-bot: sandbox ready at https://staging.redwood.ai/rivalone (id: 6220). staging keys: RIVAL_STG_6220. egress IPs: 34.82.200.10, 34.82.200.11.

Alex (AE): I'll ask them for the 2k seed + invoices and send calendar invites for kickoff. Also requesting their security questionnaire.

Sam (Security): I'll prefill common answers and flag BYOK SLA and retention for legal.

Leah (Pricing): I'll prepare two quote scenarios (hosted vs 12mo Dedicated) and show savings if they enable prefix caching + batching.

Priyanka (SE): dropping the adapter repo link and a short runbook after this thread. TL;DR: clone, set REDWOOD_KEY, run ./run_smoke.sh --sample 200.

Alex (AE): Scheduling 30m sync tomorrow 10am PT with RivalOne + SE + Sec + Pricing. Agenda: parity scope, security Qs, and pricing. Marking CRM: rivalone-swap-poc.

Ethan (RivalOne Eng): thanks — if we can get the runbook tonight well start the smoke.
